title: Hukam (crayon-book version)
music: soft synthesised harmonium drone on Sa = 92.5 Hz, ducked about 4 dB under speech
topic: Hukam: a 57s devotional talk in romanised Punjabi on accepting both joy and sorrow (non-mortgage, not a client piece)
hook: Je sukh dey, taan tujhe aaraadhi, dukh bhi tujhe dhiyaayi.
logline: A speaker's own video sits under a live-drawn crayon page that illustrates each verse; the page drops over him for about 2s to explain.
structure: Layout 1080x1920: crayon-book page in the top 720px (seven pages of live-drawn graphics), the speaker's own video in the lower 1330px, hand-lettered Roman captions at the bottom. Full-screen moments where the page drops over him. 1367 frames at 24 fps.
device: wax-crayon material physics (wax only on paper-tooth peaks, strokes boil on twos, hatched fills with overshoot, one watercolour wash resisted by white wax); page drops over the speaker to explain
lessons: Same audio and layout as hukam-urban; compare the two styles side by side before choosing.
24 fps; new work should be 30 fps.
